output.summary: An evergreen shrub or small tree native mainly to highland Colombia, southern Brazil and northeastern Uruguay, and also found in eastern Paraguay and northern Argentina. Its green autumn fruit has juicy, sweet-tart, strongly aromatic flesh; the edible pulp is commonly scooped from the halved fruit, and the flower petals are edible too.
output.edibilityNote: The skin and flower petals are edible; fruit pulp is eaten raw and used in desserts or salads.
